description: This PHP script checks whether a node with a given name exists within a specified parent container in the TestLink project. It is used to prevent duplicate node names when creating or updating nodes, facilitating user input validation. The script initializes the environment, processes input parameters, interacts with the tree management class to perform the lookup, and outputs a JSON response indicating success or failure.

classes.description: A class managing node trees within the TestLink structure, including node existence checks.

methods.description: Checks if a node with a specific name exists within a parent node, optionally excluding a specific node ID.
